summary_en: 300,000 shares (1.2% of S/O) to be acquired for up to ¥600M. Execution window: July 16, 2026 to January 12, 2027. Method not disclosed. Rationale: responsive capital policy and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On July 14, 2026, Morîto's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 300,000 shares of its own common stock for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥600M, representing 1.2% of shares outstanding (calculated as 300,000 ÷ 25,312,791 ex-treasury shares = 1.185%, rounded to 1.2%). The acquisition period runs from July 16, 2026 through January 12, 2027. The board stated the acquisition will support responsive capital allocation in response to changing business conditions and forms part of the company's shareholder return strategy. The disclosure does not specify the acquisition method (ToSTNeT-3, open-market, or self-tender) or a price ceiling per share. As of July 10, 2026, the company held 1,487,209 treasury shares against 25,312,791 issued shares excluding treasury.
